Question 10.2

38. I am not aware of the location of the switch used to shut down the FH / HR System in the 8 buildings of Wang Fuk Court and I do not know how it was shut down.

39. My general understanding is that the shutting down of a FH / HR System would not necessitate the disabling of a Fire Alarm System (“FAS”) in the same building.

Question 11

40. The FSD required additional fire extinguishers to be installed in buildings while their FH / HR Systems were suspended. This involved installing 1 fire extinguisher on alternative floors of the buildings concerned.

41. I understand that in early April 2025, Mr. Yim personally attended Wang Fuk Court to (i) accept delivery of 128 fire extinguishers from a supplier; (ii) personally stick the appropriate labels on said fire extinguishers; and (iii) deliver the fire extinguishers to PC&E for their handling of the installation.

42. The arrangement of PC&E handling the installation of additional fire extinguishers themselves was requested by PC&E.
